blockingDimension.rootCause: Stale telemetry detected (> 45 min on 3 regional river and coastal gauges: CWC Mahanadi, INCOIS Buoy, Sentinel-1)
blockingDimension.statutoryImplication: Confidence degradation forces fail-closed state; autonomous consequential actions prohibited; mandatory dual-human review enforced under DM Act 2005

dataQualityScore.calculationMethod: Deterministic weighted average of 5 telemetry feeds in adversarialTestSuite.ts (IMD 1.0, CWC 0.65, INCOIS 0.20, Sentinel-1 0.50, OPTCL SCADA 0.80 -> 3.15/5.00 = 63%)

spatialIoUMatch.calculationMethod: Static empirical benchmark in shadowModeEngine.ts and shadowEventRecorder.ts comparing predicted 151.2 sq km vs observed 142.5 sq km against Sentinel-1 SAR radar backscatter; not dynamically calculated at runtime via pixel-level raster intersection

leadTimeAdvantage.calculationMethod: Mean delta across 5 operational observation streams in shadowModeEngine.ts (IMD wind +2.5h, INCOIS surge +4.0h, CWC discharge +5.5h, OPTCL SCADA +3.0h, SAR inundation +6.0h; mean = 4.2h); pre-configured scenario baseline

backendServer.runtime: Node.js / Express 4.21.2 with Vite SPA middleware
backendServer.aiModel: gemini-3.8-flash (via @google/genai 2.4.0) with deterministic heuristic fallback when key is absent or exhausted
